author: Demo notes
title: Rumba Fan Route
cues: Forward, replace, side-and-hold; keep the side step grounded.
Back half of the basic; guide your partner out to your left into fan.
From fan, forward, replace, close, then raise your left hand for the turn.
coach_note: I used the forward half of the Basic so your right foot is free to start the Fan. Alemana is skipped: Hockey Stick ends open, but Alemana needs fan position, and there is no syllabus bridge between them. The safety screen removed one line from the notes.
skipped: Alemana — no legal bridge from Hockey Stick’s open ending to Alemana’s fan starting position.
